mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, coupon_id, status, order_no, used_time, create_time FROM `user_coupon` WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, user_id, coupon_id, status, order_no, used_time, create_time FROM `user_coupon` WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `user_coupon` WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND coupon_id = #{couponId}

SELECT uc.id, c.id AS coupon_id, c.name, c.threshold, c.amount, c.scope, c.category_id, c.end_time FROM `user_coupon` uc JOIN `coupon` c ON c.id = uc.coupon_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.status = 0 AND c.status = 1 AND (c.end_time IS NULL OR c.end_time >= NOW()) ORDER BY c.amount DESC, c.threshold ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE `user_coupon` SET status = 1, order_no = #{orderNo}, used_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 0
UPDATE `user_coupon` SET status = 0, order_no = NULL, used_time = NULL WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1
